programme.desc: Peat diggers find a head near Silkeborg, Denmark and authorities investigate whether it is related to the missing boy; the police discover that the body is much older than the missing person and call the museum to investigate.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The human remains of a woman are found near Vejle, Denmark; an archaeologist begins to tell a story about who she was and why she was murdered, connecting her to ancient fairy tales and even King Harald Bluetooth.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Two bodies are discovered near the town of Weerdinger, Netherlands; locals jump to conclusions that the two bodies belong to a man and woman united in life and death.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Human remains are discovered near Croghan Hill, Ireland, a significant place for ancient kings; the investigation takes a turn when authorities realize the body is not a current missing person or murder victim.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: In the mountains of Northern Italy, a discovery is made by a couple of mountaineers; in a nearly unreachable part of the world, human remains are found sticking out from a glacier; these turn out to be those of the oldest mummified human ever found.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Archaeologists find traces of a sea-battle that transformed Ancient Rome; archaeologists investigate how Rome rose to dominate the ancient world.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: An exploration of Herculaneum, the twin to Pompeii that also got buried during a deadly volcanic eruption; the discovery of an intact skeleton, the first excavated in 25 years, helps investigators piece together the final hours of Herculaneum.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Archaeologists investigate the fate of Nero and his buried Golden Palace.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: An exploration of Hadrian's Wall, the largest structure built by the Romans; experts examine the Wall, its forts, gatehouses, and garrison town to see how civilization and culture grew.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Archaeologists reveal how the Colosseum came to symbolize the might of Rome.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Rome
programme.desc: Archaeologists unearth a sacrificial skull, investigate a mummy, and crawl through underground tunnels as they embark on new digs in Pompeii.(n)

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt: Mighty Queens
programme.desc: Rediscovering the true legacies of queens Cleopatra, Nefertiti and Hatshepsut.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Autopsy: Mysteries of the Dead
programme.desc: Investigating whether Cleopatra died by cobra or political murder.(n)

programme.title: Ancient Autopsy: Mysteries of the Dead
programme.desc: Probe into the death of a living god with clues from tablets and forensics.(n)

programme.title: The Lost Tomb of Alexander the Great
programme.desc: Archaeologist Pepi Papakosta is on a mission to find Alexander the Great's lost tomb; excavating in the center of Alexandria, Egypt, she discovers a rare statue of Alexander and secret tunnels.(n)
